Agent response: Hello there! 😊 I'd be happy to help you understand our return and refund policy. We want you to love your Namesake product, but if you're having second thoughts, we offer a 30-day return/exchange policy from the date of delivery for items purchased directly from namesakehome.com. To be eligible for a refund, exchange, or store credit, items must be sent back in new condition and in original packaging, with all components included. Please do not modify the product in any way. For mattresses, they must remain unopened and in their original packaging. Here are some key points regarding our policy: Final Sale Items: Some products are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged. Free Returns & Exchange Coverage: If you purchased this coverage at checkout, your return shipping label will be covered for eligible items. If not, you will need to cover the cost of the return shipping label, which is typically about 25% of the retail value. Damaged Items: If you received a damaged item or are missing a piece, we can send you free replacement parts. Please visit our parts page HERE to start your request. Bundled Products: If an item from a bundle is returned, you will forfeit the discount originally applied to all items in the bundle. To initiate a return or exchange, please use our Namesake Returns Portal. After your request is accepted, you'll receive a return label and instructions via email. Please ensure all parts, pieces, printed materials, and accessories, along with the product's original packaging, are included, and remove any existing shipping labels from the box. Once your return is received and inspected, you can expect to receive a refund to your original payment method or as store credit within 3-5 days after it has been delivered back to our facilities. You can review our full return policy for more details here: Returns & Exchanges – Namesake. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
